PairTouch 13M Dataset
	

Multi-modal tactile dataset with pose, force, and tactile sensor data.

	
		
	
	
		Configs
	


	
		
Config
Description
Sensors


		
pose_data
Pose estimation data
tac02/xela + camera


force_data
Force measurement data
tac02/xela + gelsight


tacniq_gsmini
TacNIQ + GSMini data
tacniq + gsmini


xela_9dtact
XELA + 9DTact data
xela + 9dtact
